name: 非专利检索
description: Non-patent literature search tools for the agent. Ships CNKI (China National Knowledge Infrastructure) paper search and full-text reading with automatic IP-based login; other academic databases can be added as further CNKI-style tool families.

agentTools.name: CNKI_ScanPaper
agentTools.description: Search CNKI (中国知网) academic literature by subject keyword (主题字段). One call returns one result page of 20 papers, each with Title, Href (the abstract page), Abstract, and HTML_READING_URL (the online HTML reading link, the input for CNKI_GetPaperMainBody), plus totalHits and totalPage (= ceil(totalHits / 20)); start at pageNum 1 and increase pageNum to read further pages. Login is automatic (IP-based, the CNKI whitelist of the current network); no cookie handling is needed or exposed. The search is one request and each paper adds one throttled abstract-page request, so a call takes about 30-60 s. Unavailable abstract pages leave Abstract/HTML_READING_URL empty and are listed in warnings; if warnings report human verification, wait a few minutes before the next call. Impact factors are not included.

value.description: Search keyword(s) for the CNKI subject field (主题).

pageNum.description: One-based CNKI result page to return (default 1). Each page holds 20 papers; totalPage in the result says how many pages exist.

agentTools.name: CNKI_GetPaperMainBody
agentTools.description: Fetch the full text of one CNKI paper from its HTML_READING_URL (as returned by CNKI_ScanPaper) and return it as plain text: the title, then each chapter heading followed by its paragraphs. No HTML, no JSON, no escape sequences. Only papers whose full text the current CNKI subscription may read are available; otherwise a structured error explains why.

href.description: The HTML_READING_URL of one paper, exactly as returned by CNKI_ScanPaper.
